engines.name: Standard Chat & Vision
engines.summary: Everyday local chat, coding, reasoning, tool calling, and image Q&A for dense transformer models.
engines.accel_note: Dense language layers run on the NPU (with host CPU ViT image encoding when Qwen-VL images are attached), keeping your CPU and GPU free.

engines.name: Qwen 3.5 Long-Context Chat & Vision
engines.summary: Hybrid linear-attention runtime built for long documents, vision Q&A, and coding sessions from 0.8B up to 27B.
engines.accel_tip: Linear & gated attention layers and FFN projections run on the NPU; recurrent state updates during multi-token prompt prefill and ViT image encoding (when images are attached) run on the CPU.
engines.accel_note: Keeps KV-cache memory low across 32k to 256k token coding, document, and image Q&A sessions.

engines.name: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Chat & Vision
engines.summary: Runs high-capacity 35B reasoning and vision models fast on unified memory by activating only 3B parameters per token.
engines.accel_tip: Shared layers, active expert projections, and attention run on the NPU; Mixture-of-Experts token routing, long-prompt recurrent state updates, and ViT image encoding (when images are attached) run on the CPU.
engines.accel_note: Activates 3B parameters per token for fast 35B generation on unified memory.

engines.name: Liquid LFM2 Chat
engines.summary: Compact, low-memory runtime for Liquid AI 1.2B and 2.6B assistants on thin-and-light laptops.
engines.accel_tip: Short-convolution projections, gated attention, and FFN layers run on the NPU; short-conv state carry during prompt prefill runs on the CPU.
engines.accel_note: Fits in ~1 to 2 GB of RAM alongside IDEs, browsers, or embedding models.

engines.name: Batched Text Embeddings
engines.summary: High-throughput document indexing and semantic search across 6 compiled BERT, BGE, Nomic, and GTE encoders.
engines.accel_note: Encoder matrix math runs on the NPU across batches up to 128 texts; CPU handles tokenization and final vector pooling.

engines.name: EmbeddingGemma
engines.summary: Longer-passage 2,048-token text embeddings for multilingual retrieval and single-query lookups.
engines.accel_tip: Linear and FFN projections run on the NPU (npu_matmul_f32); bidirectional attention and vector pooling across 2,048-token inputs run on the CPU (falls back to CPU on source-built NixOS #244).
engines.accel_note: Encodes full 2,048-token passages in one pass without splitting long paragraphs.

engines.name: FLUX.2 Image Generation & Editing
engines.summary: Offline text-to-image synthesis and single-reference photo restyling in 4 steps.
engines.accel_note: Prompt encoding, diffusion steps, and image decoding all run on the NPU; CPU only resizes input photos and writes PNG files.

engines.name: Whisper Speech-to-Text
engines.summary: Offline voice transcription for audio files, CLI voice input, and Open WebUI microphone dictation.
engines.accel_tip: Default whisper-v3:turbo .q4nx shortcut runs on inherited prebuilt Whisper NPU kernels + libwhisper_npu (omitted on source-built NixOS #244). Open NPU + CPU Whisper (32-layer encoder projections on NPU; conv/attention + 4-layer token decoder on CPU) is in source and awaits prebuilt kernel packaging (#240).
engines.accel_note: Transcribes 30-second audio windows via whisper-v3:turbo; open NPU + CPU GGUF kernel packaging is tracked in #240.

engines.name: Inherited Closed NPU Shortcuts
engines.summary: Temporary prebuilt NPU kernel and closed shared-library runtimes being phased out as remaining models move to open kernels.
engines.accel_tip: Uses inherited prebuilt NPU binaries and closed runtime libraries on fixed .q4nx shortcuts only; requires explicit OFLM_<FAMILY>_ENGINE=closed opt-in on most families (no silent fallback) and is omitted from source-built NixOS packages (#244).
engines.accel_note: Supports fixed .q4nx shortcuts only (no GGUF loading), requires explicit opt-in where open text engines exist, and is omitted on NixOS (#244).
